svg.title: Per-rotation compression in round 1 — synthetic sample — not a measurement
svg.desc: Each point is the compression-per-rotation entry for one rotation, plotted against elapsed seconds in one synthetic round. The points are not joined; no smoothing, trend or measured behaviour is claimed.
